file_id: M.Shabarish, vs The State Of Telangana, on 7 March, 2025

sentences.text: M.Shabarish, vs The State Of Telangana, on 7 March, 2025

Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.9893 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS by the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 3, 4 and 5 to quash the proceedings against them in S.C.No.258 of 2024 on the file of X Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Kukatpally, presently at Khaithalapur, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 306, 498A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: X Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 24.02.2025, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 04.03.2025 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025 is allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 3, 4 and 5 in S.C.No.258 of 2024 on the file of X Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Kukatpally, (presently at Khaithalapur), are hereby quashed.

entities.text: X Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Cyberabad at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
JUVVADI SRIDEVI, J Date:07.03.2025 Note: Issue C.C. by 11.03.2025.
